In Cobble ValleyWhat is this?
  • Gym badges drive the ages. Every different gym leader anyone in the group beats is one group badge: 1 opens the Iron Age, 3 the Diamond Age, 5 the Nether Age, 8 the End Age. Beating every Champion opens the Champion Age.
  • Sinnoh leaders count once, whichever of their two fights you win. Badges earned while someone is offline still count when they log in.
  • Every win against a gym leader, the Elite Four or a Champion also drops a Prize Crate for the group's current age.

Any item: Item Lookup. Outside Cobble Valley (Our World, LAN worlds) none of this applies.
